subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should maintainers accept the deterministic Gateway/qa-channel proof and waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary as sufficient to merge this message-delivery fix?
rationale: The patch is narrow and well-covered, but it changes which transcript rows are eligible for visible A2A delivery, which green CI cannot fully prove for every real channel history.

options.title: Accept Boundary
options.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the fix targets the duplicate visible-message failure and the QA scenario exercises the source sessions_send plus target message(action=send) path.

options.title: Require Live Channel Proof
options.body: Ask for an additional redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent channel run before merge if QA Gateway proof is not enough for this delivery path.

options.title: Defer To A2A Coordination
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want this mirror fix bundled with the reverse-send and compaction duplicate-delivery work.

recommendation.title: Accept Boundary
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the fix targets the duplicate visible-message failure and the QA scenario exercises the source sessions_send plus target message(action=send) path.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest recent history on the delivery-mirror transcript provenance and delayed sessions_send reply paths.
